source: PR #49 CodeRabbit review comments 4321186995 and 4321186999; PR #50 review comments 4321249852, 4321249865 and 4321304932

findings.claim: tui-mount.ts falls back to dsh-tui@0.15.0 when MPD_E2E_TUI_VERSION is unset; 0.15.0 refuses harness 0.2.1-rc.2, so the default QA install can fail.
findings.evidence: skills/dsh-qa/scripts/tui-mount.ts:191 read before the fix; docker/tui-lane.sh:245 defaults to 0.16.1; 0.15.0's peer bands stop at 0.2.0-rc.2.
findings.fix: TUI_HOST_SPEC and its PREREQ now default to 0.16.1; the same install/remedy string was aligned in seven other QA carriers (tui-team-surface, tui-admission, install-dependencies, lib/tui-lane, tui-deps-ctrla, tui-panels, tui-keeper-standdown).

findings.claim: docs/tui.md §11.8 claims the TUI lane inspects the installed host's peer band and records tui.hostPeerBound, which the implementation does not do.
findings.evidence: No hostPeerBound/peerBand implementation exists in skills/scripts/docker; the peer bound was deliberately deleted in 162bcdcb ('delete the peer bound'). docker/tui-lane.sh uses fixed TUI_VERSION and MPD_E2E_DSH_VERSION pins and records tui.hostInstall / tui.pluginAddHost / tui.pluginAddBundle / tui.compose; a peer refusal makes tui.pluginAddHost false and ends the lane red.
findings.fix: §11.8 (EN + zh-CN) now describes the fixed-pin behavior and explicitly says the lane does not inspect peer ranges or record tui.hostPeerBound.

findings.claim: tui-keeper-standdown.ts's header still said 'INSTALLED 0.15.0+ host', which contradicts the 0.2.1-rc.2 baseline (0.15.0 is refused on peer ranges).
findings.evidence: The first fix widened the header to '0.15.0+' while the default host moved to 0.16.1; the two statements disagreed.
findings.fix: The header now reads 'INSTALLED 0.16.1 host', matching the QA default and the Docker lane.

findings.claim: The PR edits files under skills/ but does not update VENDOR_LOCK.json, so verify-vendor rejects the stale skills treeSha.
findings.evidence: node scripts/verify-vendor.ts FAILED with 'asset skills treeSha mismatch' before the re-pin; the Static gates CI step failed at the aggregate gate for the same reason.
findings.fix: Ran node scripts/repin-vendor.ts --write --i-know-this-is-the-captains-step once, after the last skills edit, and amended VENDOR_LOCK.json into the SAME commit (skills.treeSha c85dc14f… -> 5b77726a…). verify-vendor now PASS.

findings.claim: skills/dsh-qa/SKILL.md:121 still described the tui-keeper-standdown lane as running on an installed 0.15.0 host.
findings.evidence: SKILL.md:121 read before the fix; the lane's default is now 0.16.1, so the row's host claim was stale.
findings.fix: The row now says 'installed 0.16.1 host'; the tui-admission row's 0.15.0 rename history was left untouched. The skills treeSha was re-pinned once more in the same amended commit.

gates.verify-vendor: PASS after the single re-pin (skills treeSha 5b77726a…)

bounds: Docs-only correction for CR-2: the peer-range diagnostic was NOT re-implemented; 162bcdcb deliberately removed it, so the documentation follows the shipped behavior.
The QA host-default fix is a string/default change; no product package code or dist artifact changed.
Exactly ONE vendor re-pin landed, in the same commit as the skills edit that invalidated the treeSha.
